nodes.name: README.md

nodes.summary: NestJS CLI configuration setting src as the source root with the schematics collection and a deleteOutDir compiler option.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root npm manifest for the NestJS v11 backend declaring runtime dependencies for JWT auth, Prisma, and validation, plus dev tooling, npm scripts, and embedded Jest unit-test configuration.

nodes.name: skills-lock.json
nodes.summary: Lockfile pinning nine Prisma skill snapshots from prisma/skills with source paths and content hashes for reproducible agent guidance.

nodes.summary: Production build TypeScript configuration extending the base config while excluding node_modules, test, dist, frontend, and spec files.
